key_concepts: Conductors allow electricity to flow through them.
Insulators do not allow electricity to flow through them.
A closed circuit is needed to light a bulb.
Metal items such as paper clips and coins can complete a circuit.
Nonmetal items such as erasers and paper bills do not complete a circuit.
Increasing battery voltage makes a bulb brighter.
Low voltage produces dim light while high voltage produces bright light.
A simple circuit includes a battery, bulb, and wires.
Everyday objects rely on electrical circuits.
Understanding conductors and insulators helps with electrical safety.
